quality_rules.rule: Avoid ambiguous words that don't have a clear, measurable definition.
quality_rules.explanation: These words are subject to varying interpretations. Numerical values (e.g., 'under 2 seconds') should be used instead.

quality_rules.rule: Avoid subjective terms that depend on personal opinion.
quality_rules.explanation: These phrases leave it unclear when the requirement will be applied.

quality_rules.rule: Requirements must be testable and verifiable.
quality_rules.explanation: Concepts like 100% error-free or 'best' cannot be tested. Acceptance criteria must be concrete.

quality_rules.rule: Avoid words that imply an infinite or indefinite state.
quality_rules.explanation: System states should be defined under specific triggers and conditions.

functional: The system shall allow users to upload a PDF document for analysis.
The system must generate an email notification when a new issue is detected.
The user shall be able to filter search results by date and category.
The database shall store all user-provided requirement text for up to 5 years.
The system shall provide a dashboard showing the status of all active projects.
non_functional: The system shall process a 50-page document in less than 2 minutes.
All user passwords must be encrypted using AES-256 before storage.
The system shall be available 99.9% of the time during business hours.
The interface shall adhere to WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standards.
The application shall support at least 500 concurrent users without degradation.
